about: How Brewlab fills a grinder's empty grind-range rows from its other ranges (the gear editor's “Estimate the empty rows”, and the library's estimated rows). Rules run in `order`; a row filled earlier can feed a later one. For each method the first alternative whose `needs` are all present wins. Expressions use <method>.low / .high / .mid / .span, `min` (the grinder's physical minimum, else 0), numbers, + - * / and parentheses. Results are rounded to the grinder's step and kept inside its min/max.
notePrefix: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source:

batch.note: drip coffee maker: the pour-over range

aeropress.note: AeroPress: between the espresso and pour-over ranges (or one pour-over span finer when there's no espresso range)
AeroPress: between the espresso and pour-over ranges (or one pour-over span finer when there's no espresso range)

moka pot: from the top of the espresso range to halfway to the top of the AeroPress range (or one AeroPress span finer when there's no espresso range)

immersion.note: French press: the cold brew range moved half its width finer

rapid.note: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range
